scope: Source-certified Scum and Villainy talents compared against the current repository talent-record mirror. No production records changed.

phase1dStructuralCorrections.reason: Bolster Ally is printed as a prerequisite of Beloved, not the Scum expansion talent.
Draw Fire is only a cross-tree reference inside Misplaced Loyalty; the Disgrace tree publishes six talents.

candidates.name: Deadly Repercussions
candidates.benefit: When you reduce an opponent to 0 hp, all opponents in line of sight of you and the target take -2 attack until your next turn.
candidates.description: When you reduce an opponent to 0 hit points, all enemies in line of sight take –2 attack until your next turn.

candidates.name: Manipulating Strike
candidates.benefit: Once per turn, when you damage a target with a non-area attack, make Persuasion vs Will Defense to control that target's swift action.
candidates.description: Once per turn, after damaging a target, make a Persuasion check to determine their next swift action.

candidates.name: Improved Manipulating Strike
candidates.benefit: Once per turn, when you damage a target with a non-area attack, make Persuasion vs Will Defense to control that target's move action.
candidates.description: Once per turn, after damaging a target, make a Persuasion check to determine their next move action.

candidates.name: Pulling the Strings
candidates.benefit: Make Persuasion vs Will Defense within 12 squares to move the target half its speed toward you and make an immediate attack.
candidates.description: Use Persuasion vs Will Defense to move a target toward you and force an immediate attack.

candidates.name: Keep Them Reeling
candidates.benefit: Once per turn, make an opposed Initiative check vs your prime target; if you win, the prime target is flat-footed against you.
candidates.description: Make a melee attack; if it hits, deal no damage but force the target to move or withdraw next turn.

confirmedHighImpactContentDefects.name: Beloved
confirmedHighImpactContentDefects.notes: Repository Guardian summary reverses the beneficiary: the source gives the character +2 Reflex while near the chosen ally; it does not give the ally +2 Reflex.

confirmedHighImpactContentDefects.name: Cunning Strategist
confirmedHighImpactContentDefects.notes: Repository Vicious Attack summary changes the mechanic: the source imposes -5 on the character's two attack rolls, not a -5 attack penalty on the targets.

confirmedHighImpactContentDefects.name: Keep it Together
confirmedHighImpactContentDefects.notes: Repository benefit is broadly source-aligned, but its description incorrectly says the vehicle simply avoids moving down the condition track once per encounter.

confirmedHighImpactContentDefects.name: Murderous Arts II
confirmedHighImpactContentDefects.notes: Repository changes '+1 die of damage' to '+1d6 damage'.
